facts.fact: Nextdoor introduced Local Deals, an advertising offering that lets businesses, service providers, and neighbors for hire target ads to people in their neighborhood.
facts.quote: Neighborhood social network Nextdoor has introduced an advertising offering it calls Local Deals that allows businesses, service providers, and neighbors for hire to target advertisements

facts.fact: Local Deals launched in the U.S. with a global rollout planned for the following year, and businesses with free Nextdoor business pages can create Local Deals.
facts.quote: Beginning Tuesday in the U.S., with plans for a global rollout next year, businesses that have set up their free business pages on Nextdoor can create Local Deals.

facts.fact: According to Nextdoor, the platform supports more than 248,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries.
facts.quote: The platform -- a combination of word of mouth, search and hyperlocal targeting -- supports more than 248,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries.

facts.fact: Nextdoor reports 40 million recommendations on its platform, per head of product Tatyana Mamut.
facts.quote: With 40 million recommendations and 76% of members sharing that they’ve been influenced by a neighbor’s suggestion on Nextdoor

facts.fact: Nextdoor says 76% of its members report being influenced by a neighbor's suggestion on Nextdoor.
facts.quote: 76% of members sharing that they’ve been influenced by a neighbor’s suggestion on Nextdoor

facts.fact: A third-party research cited in the article finds that about 93% of consumers make the majority of their everyday purchases within 20 minutes of home.
facts.quote: For about 93% of consumers, the majority of their everyday purchases are made within 20 minutes of their home, according to research

facts.fact: The article states that about 87% of consumers travel no more than 15 minutes from home (the article does not explicitly attribute this figure to a source).
facts.quote: About 87% travel no more than 15 minutes from their home

facts.fact: La Fiorentina Steakhouse Italiana in Punta Gorda, Florida reported breakfast sales grew 20% with the help of Local Deals, per manager Sue Randall.
facts.quote: Sue Randall, manager of La Fiorentina Steakhouse Italiana, reported that breakfast sales grew 20% with the help of Local Deals.
